question: The FCoE technology is used in a data center and the MDS switches are configured as Fibre Channel Forwarders. Which configuration should be applied to an MDS switch in order to be used as the best switch to connect by the CNAs in the fabric?
theory: When multiple Cisco Nexus/MDS switches act as Fibre Channel Forwarders (FCFs) in an FCoE fabric, each one advertises an FCF priority value in the range 0 (highest preference) to 255 (lowest), with 128 as the default; CNAs use this priority during FIP FCF discovery to pick the 'best' switch to log in to. To make a specific switch the preferred FCF for all CNAs in the fabric, you configure it with the lowest priority value available - 'fcoe fcf-priority 0' - since a lower number wins. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 9 - FCoE Overview / FCF Priority)
